environment.description: Same NestJS service deployed in namespace 'frontend' on the same GKE cluster. Istio mesh is in STRICT mTLS mode. A single AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the mesh level (root namespace 'istio-system') with a DENY action matching source principals not in the 'frontend' namespace for workloads in 'frontend'. However, the SSRF target is internal services in OTHER namespaces (payments, admin). Additionally, a second AuthorizationPolicy in the 'frontend' namespace uses a CUSTOM action delegating to an ext_authz provider ('opa-envoy') that evaluates egress destination against an allowlist of hostnames. The OPA policy (rego) permits outbound HTTP only to *.frontend.svc.cluster.local and two explicitly listed external domains. Note: the metadata endpoint bypass via metadata.google.internal is separately blocked by GKE Workload Identity federation being enabled on the node pool, which disables the legacy metadata API path entirely.

config.opa_rego_policy: allow if { dest_host_suffix == '.frontend.svc.cluster.local' } OR allow if { dest_host in ['api.partner.com', 'cdn.assets.io'] }
